docs.title: Welcome!
docs.text:
I am an electrical engineer based in the Chicagoland area of Illinois. Welcome to my personal website.

Here you can find my resume and some information about my personal projects. My projects consist of a mix of radio frequency (RF) systems and power systems simulations and computational tools, as I had my start in RF but more recently I am becoming more involved in the power world.

The future is bright! Let's get to work...

docs.title: RF Systems Engineer
docs.text:
September 2023 – Present

  • Design, development, and test of RF systems including radar and GPS/INS systems for aerospace and defense engineering programs.
  • Coordinated system and software requirements, design, and code reviews for embedded avionics software developed under DO-178C commercial flight standards.
  • Supported formal engineering processes including requirements traceability, design reviews, verification activities, and configuration management.
  • Designed and evaluated radar processing algorithms using MATLAB, analyzing performance trade-offs under varying input conditions.
  • Configured avionics firmware to satisfy system behavioral requirements across operational and test scenarios.
  • Presented technical analyses and recommendations to senior engineers to support design decisions.

docs.title: Engineering Consultant
docs.text:

  • Provided technical guidance on ZigBee wireless protocols and associated hardware.
  • Refactored embedded C software for portable gas sensor communications.
  • Improved wireless communication reliability through implementation of message queuing techniques.

docs.title: Electrical Engineer Intern
docs.text:
June 2023 – August 2023

  • Continued development of embedded software for portable in-situ gas sensors used in environmental monitoring applications.
  • Developed C software enabling wireless communication between sensor nodes.
  • Developed C++/Qt graphical user interface software for wireless sensor network data collection.
  • Configured RF transceiver firmware to satisfy network behavioral requirements.
  • Supported field testing activities with NYSEARCH Natural Gas R&D and EagleHawk drone operators.

  • Co-authored conference paper presented at the 2023 International Conference on Environmental Systems (ICES).

docs.title: Graduate Research Assistant
docs.text:
November 2022 – May 2023

  • Conducted research on localization of down-wind methane gas leaks using UAV-mounted portable gas sensors.
  • Used the Quick Urban & Industrial Complex (QUIC) Dispersion Modeling System developed by Los Alamos National Laboratory.
  • Tuned simulation parameters using empirical field data and computational performance considerations.
  • Automated simulation parameter sweeps using Python on Linux systems.
  • Generated lookup tables for Bayesian localization algorithms using UAV GPS and weather data.
  • Participated in field testing with NYSEARCH Natural Gas R&D and EagleHawk drone operators.
  • Co-authored an IEEE Access journal publication.
